title: THE ELEVATOR TO HELL 🏫
topic: The conspiracy of the hidden school floor and Nix's parents.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: IF WE ENTER THIS ELEVATOR [beat] THERE IS NO COMING BACK FOR ANY OF US!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Shut up and hack the keypad [beat] because Huda is literally ten seconds away from turning us into school history!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: My dad's security clearance shouldn't work here [beat] but the scanner just turned green like it was waiting for me.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The school records said this building only had four floors [beat] so why is the elevator panel showing a negative thirteen?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You meddling little parasites [beat] step away from that door before I make sure you never graduate from this life!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: Look at the monitor [beat] that's Nix's mom and dad talking to the principal like they own the entire school board!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: The experiment is reaching the final stage [beat] so if the children interfere [beat] you have our permission to neutralize them.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: My own mother just gave the order to hunt me down [beat] like I'm some kind of lab rat in their twisted basement!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Don't be emotional [beat] Nix was always just a variable in the data set [beat] and the data demands a sacrifice.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The doors are opening [beat] but this isn't a basement [beat] it's a massive server room filled with frozen students!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Welcome to the real curriculum boys [beat] where we don't teach you history [beat] we use your brains to write it.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: This isn't a school [beat] it's a harvesting plant [beat] and look at the name on that central cryo-pod!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The basement level holds a secret [beat] that makes the lockdown look like a playground game of tag.
